inputs.description:

S2：因为它们都有主人在等。有的少了一只耳朵，有的缝线开了，但大家舍不得换新的。

S1：所以不能一味修得太整齐。要是突然变成全新的样子，可能反而认不出来了。

inputs.label: 角色 S1
inputs.description: 参观者／第一次进展馆的观众

inputs.label: 角色 S2
inputs.description: 导览员／虚构城市美术馆讲解人

inputs.label: 完整台词
inputs.description:
S1：这幅画的窗户为什么只开了一半？我第一眼看到的，反而是那块没有画人的空地。
S2：你可以先看看窗边那把椅子。椅背朝着我们，坐过的人好像刚刚起身。
S1：这样一看，空地也不像空着了。我会猜，那个人是去开门，或者迎接一个朋友。
S2：这正是观察有趣的地方。画面没有给出全部答案，却留下了让你接着想的线索。
S1：我以前总急着看旁边的说明牌，怕自己看不懂。今天倒想先多站一会儿。
S2：不妨试试。再向右挪半步，看窗外的光落在哪里，也许你会找到新的故事。
S1：找到了，光正好照着门口。那我愿意把它理解成，一个人正在等另一个人回家。
S2：欢迎把这个答案带走。下一幅画也在前面等你，别急，每一次停留都算一次相遇。

角色.S1: 行者／寻找古桥的旅行者

inputs.label: 角色 S1
inputs.description: 行者／寻找古桥的旅行者

inputs.label: 角色 S2
inputs.description: 守桥人／森林里的向导

inputs.label: 完整台词
inputs.description:
S1：你说通往山谷的桥就在这里，可我只看见河水，还有三块会发光的石头。
S2：桥没有消失，它只是睡着了。仔细听，左边的石头是不是发出了一声很低的回响？
S1：听到了。中间那块更高一点，右边像一声清脆的铃响。我该按什么顺序碰它们？
S2：别着急猜答案。先想一想，你进森林时，风铃替你唱过的那段旋律。
S1：低的、高的，然后是中间那个音。我记起来了，原来沿路的声音一直在给我提示。
S2：现在试试看，每次碰一下就停住，等河面上亮起一道光，再碰下一块。
S1：成功了！石桥真的从水里升起来了。走过去以后，我还能听见这段旋律吗？
S2：当然。只要你愿意停下来听，森林会一直回答你。走吧，山谷的灯已经亮了。

inputs.label: 角色 S1
inputs.description: 陆川／即将离职的观测员

inputs.label: 角色 S2
inputs.description: 许晴／前来交接的同事

inputs.label: 完整台词
inputs.description:
S2：交接表都签好了。你真的不再等一晚吗？天气预报说，后半夜云可能会散。
S1：已经等了一个星期，再等下去，我怕自己又舍不得走了。山下的新工作还等着呢。
S2：那至少把这本观测日志带走。最后一页是空的，你说过，要留给最好看的那次星空。
S1：我记得。刚来的时候，连北极星都要找半天，现在闭着眼睛都知道窗外是什么方向。
S2：熟悉的地方也不会因为你离开就消失。哪天想回来，给我发条消息，我替你留门。
S1：谢谢。等一下，窗边是不是有一点光？你先别开灯，让眼睛慢慢适应。
S2：云真的散了。你看，整个山谷都暗下来了，今晚的星星比昨天还清楚。
S1：那就再坐一会儿吧。车可以等下一班，这一页，终于知道该写什么了。

cases.textResult:
（1）完整顺序：

第1位F，第2位E，第3位G，第4位C，第5位A，第6位H，第7位D，第8位B。

即：F E G C A H D B

（2）唯一性排除依据：

由条件2知E与A间隔两人，设E在第i位则A在i+3位；结合条件9（E≠1,8），i只能取2、3、4、5。逐一检验：
- i=3时，推得B只能在第1位，违反条件8（B须在C后）；
- i=4时，D与A间隔一人要求D在第5或9位，均被占或越界；
- i=5时，同理D无合法位置。
仅i=2可完整排布且满足全部条件，故解唯一。

（3）逐条核验：

1. C紧接G后：G第3、C第4 ✓
2. A在E后隔两人：E第2、A第5，中间为3、4位 ✓
3. D与A间隔一人：A第5、D第7，中间为6位 ✓
4. H严格位于A与D之间：H在第6位 ✓
5. F与E相邻：F第1、E第2 ✓
6. F在G前：1<3 ✓
7. G在A前：3<5 ✓
8. B在C后：B第8>C第4 ✓
9. E非首尾：E在第2位 ✓

FINAL_ORDER: F E G C A H D B

inputs.description: English sung lead vocal, youthful raspy energetic delivery with group backing shouts. Fast melodic punk rock, 160 BPM E major, downstroke overdriven power chords, tight electric bass, urgent acoustic drums, live garage energy, punchy verses and singalong choruses, short raw guitar solo, strong final chord. Original composition, evolving full five-minute form, clear section contrasts, complete resolved ending. High fidelity stereo recording.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The last bus left without a sound
Our names are chalk upon the ground
The factory clock is running late
We hang our hopes outside the gate
A broken radio starts to sing
We make a crown from bits of string
No golden ticket in our hands
Just borrowed chords and stubborn plans

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the lights toward the street
Hear the thunder of our feet
Every voice can start a flame
We are more than just a name

[Chorus 1]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Verse 2]
The corner shop has shut its door
We paint a window on the floor
The rent goes up, the roof comes down
We build a stage across the town
The drummer counts us back to life
A spark against the endless night
The future has no velvet rope
We stitch our jackets out of hope

[Chorus 2]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
If the power fades away
We will sing until the day
One small match against the rain
Light the city up again

[Final Chorus]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Outro]

[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The last bus left without a sound
Our names are chalk upon the ground
The factory clock is running late
We hang our hopes outside the gate
A broken radio starts to sing
We make a crown from bits of string
No golden ticket in our hands
Just borrowed chords and stubborn plans

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn the lights toward the street
Hear the thunder of our feet
Every voice can start a flame
We are more than just a name

[Chorus 1]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Verse 2]
The corner shop has shut its door
We paint a window on the floor
The rent goes up, the roof comes down
We build a stage across the town
The drummer counts us back to life
A spark against the endless night
The future has no velvet rope
We stitch our jackets out of hope

[Chorus 2]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Bridge]
If the power fades away
We will sing until the day
One small match against the rain
Light the city up again

[Final Chorus]
We are the noise beyond the wall
We catch each other when we fall
Raise up a song the night can hear
Tomorrow starts with us right here
We are the noise beyond the wall
A thousand hearts inside this hall
The morning has an open door
We keep on asking for much more

[Outro]

inputs.description: English sung lead vocal, warm unforced storytelling with gentle harmony on choruses. Acoustic country folk ballad, 88 BPM G major, fingerpicked steel-string guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, fiddle replies and restrained pedal steel, porch-like intimacy, instrumental bridge, heartfelt homecoming ending. Original composition, evolving full five-minute form, clear section contrasts, complete resolved ending. High fidelity stereo recording.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
A faded map beside the wheel
A little town behind the hill
The windmill turns above the grain
I hear your voice inside the rain
The diner closes after nine
The river bends beyond the pines
I keep a lantern in the car
To show me where the old roads are

[Pre-Chorus]
Far away or close behind
Home is what the heart can find
Every road beneath the sun
Brings me back to where begun

[Chorus 1]
Leave a light beside the door
I am coming home once more
Past the bridge and through the rain
I will learn your roads again
Leave a light beside the door
For the ones still looking for
A place to lay their burdens down
On the quiet side of town

[Verse 2]
Your letters sleep beneath the seat
The gravel sings below my feet
A porch light shines across the field
Some things a highway cannot heal
I learned the names of distant skies
And brought their colors in my eyes
But every mile of wandering home
Has taught me where my roots have grown

[Chorus 2]
Leave a light beside the door
I am coming home once more
Past the bridge and through the rain
I will learn your roads again
Leave a light beside the door
For the ones still looking for
A place to lay their burdens down
On the quiet side of town

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
We are more than where we go
More than all the miles we know
When the evening settles low
There is still a place to grow

[Final Chorus]
Leave a light beside the door
I am coming home once more
Past the bridge and through the rain
I will learn your roads again
Leave a light beside the door
For the ones still looking for
A place to lay their burdens down
On the quiet side of town

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
My grandmother kept a radio
Where the river meets the railroad
She taught my hands a clapping time
And put a little fire in mine
The summer leaned against the door
A bass line rose up through the floor
The whole block found a place to stand
And passed the chorus hand to hand

[Pre-Chorus]
Listen to the wheels below
Feel the rising undertow
Every road and every scar
Made the voices that we are

[Chorus 1]
Roll that river, carry me
From the sorrow to the sea
Let the backbeat lift the stone
Nobody has to walk alone
Roll that river, carry me
Let the morning set us free
Raise that voice and make it known
Every heart deserves a home

[Verse 2]
A guitar cried across the room
Then turned that sorrow into bloom
We took the long way through the night
And brought the corner back to light
The old piano lost a key
But still it had enough for me
A voice can carry what it knows
And plant a garden where it goes

[Chorus 2]
Roll that river, carry me
From the sorrow to the sea
Let the backbeat lift the stone
Nobody has to walk alone
Roll that river, carry me
Let the morning set us free
Raise that voice and make it known
Every heart deserves a home

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
Take the hurt and let it ring
Give the tired a song to sing
When the daylight breaks in two
I will stand right here with you

[Final Chorus]
Roll that river, carry me
From the sorrow to the sea
Let the backbeat lift the stone
Nobody has to walk alone
Roll that river, carry me
Let the morning set us free
Raise that voice and make it known
Every heart deserves a home

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The iron mountain drinks the rain
We climb beyond the rusted chain
The city hums beneath our boots
A forest growing steel for roots
No borrowed fire can light the way
We forge a spark against the gray
The weight we carry makes us strong
We turn the hammer into song

[Pre-Chorus]
Count the sparks against the sky
Lift the flame and hold it high
When the night comes rolling through
We have work enough to do

[Chorus 1]
Carry the fire through the rain
Rise from the iron once again
Hear all the broken bells align
This is our mountain, this our climb
Carry the fire through the rain
Nothing we build has been in vain
Under the thunder we remain
And give the dawn another name

[Verse 2]
A thousand windows face the storm
A thousand hands can keep us warm
We build a bridge across the fall
And carve a doorway through the wall
The river will not leave its bed
The dawn is rising overhead
We bend but never break apart
The furnace lives inside the heart

[Chorus 2]
Carry the fire through the rain
Rise from the iron once again
Hear all the broken bells align
This is our mountain, this our climb
Carry the fire through the rain
Nothing we build has been in vain
Under the thunder we remain
And give the dawn another name

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
Slow the hammer, hear the heart
Even embers make a start
From the silence, from the stone
We will build a brighter home

[Final Chorus]
Carry the fire through the rain
Rise from the iron once again
Hear all the broken bells align
This is our mountain, this our climb
Carry the fire through the rain
Nothing we build has been in vain
Under the thunder we remain
And give the dawn another name

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The station clock forgets the hour
Rain collects on concrete flowers
A telephone without a tone
The empty square becomes a home
Your shadow crosses through the glass
A train of borrowed faces passed
I count the lights along the stair
And leave a little silence there

[Pre-Chorus]
Walk until the wires end
Let the empty city bend
Every signal, every light
Draws a map across the night

[Chorus 1]
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A quiet room behind the fire
We are the footsteps after rain
We are the voices that remain
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A little more than we require
Leave one window open wide
Let the waking world inside

[Verse 2]
A paper moon above the lane
The traffic paints the walls again
A neon bird with folded wings
Remembers all the smaller things
Your coat is hanging by the door
The morning moves across the floor
Between the spaces in the sound
We find the lives we lost and found

[Chorus 2]
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A quiet room behind the fire
We are the footsteps after rain
We are the voices that remain
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A little more than we require
Leave one window open wide
Let the waking world inside

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
No address upon the sky
Still the distant lights reply
In the space between the trains
Something in the city stays

[Final Chorus]
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A quiet room behind the fire
We are the footsteps after rain
We are the voices that remain
There is a heartbeat in the wire
A little more than we require
Leave one window open wide
Let the waking world inside

[Outro]

inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
They put a chain across the meeting room
And left our posters curling in the rain
The corner shop still hums a broken tune
I hear it on the last bus home again
You found the key beneath a window frame
I brought the tools my father left to me
We swept the dust and called each other names
Like every joke could set a sleeper free
A dozen coats were drying by the door
A little amp was balanced on a chair
We tapped our feet against the empty floor
And found a song already waiting there

[Pre-Chorus]
If they can hear us through the boarded glass
They know these empty days are going to pass
Count every voice before you count the cost
We are still here, and none of us are lost

[Chorus 1]
We are the lights they forgot to count
We are the hands that can pull us out
Open the door, let the whole street in
Give every broken bell room to ring
Nobody here has to stand alone
Nobody buys the right to a home
Write our names where the paint has peeled
Tell them a promise is something real
One more voice and the walls come down
One more heart in this waking town
We are the lights they forgot to count
Turn us up, we are coming out

[Verse 2]
The baker came with coffee after dawn
The driver parked and carried in the chairs
A mother brought the coat her kid outgrew
And stayed to help us fix the broken stairs
We painted over years of closing signs
In yellow brighter than the passing trains
The oldest man could barely read our lines
But knew the tune before the first refrain
No camera came to tell us what to feel
No perfect speech could make the winter kind
We built a place from what our hands could heal
And left the heavy chains we found behind

[Chorus 2]
We are the lights they forgot to count
We are the hands that can pull us out
Open the door, let the whole street in
Give every broken bell room to ring
Nobody here has to stand alone
Nobody buys the right to a home
Write our names where the paint has peeled
Tell them a promise is something real
One more voice and the walls come down
One more heart in this waking town
We are the lights they forgot to count
Turn us up, we are coming out

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Maybe the roof will leak another year
Maybe the rent will rise before the spring
But put your hand beside my shaking hand
And hear how many voices one room brings
We do not need a hero on a screen
We need a place to catch our breath and try
The smallest light can show the next step home
The darkest street is learning how to shine

[Final Chorus]
We are the lights they forgot to count
We are the hands that can pull us out
Open the door, let the whole street in
Give every broken bell room to ring
Nobody here has to stand alone
Nobody buys the right to a home
Write our names where the paint has peeled
Tell them a promise is something real
One more voice and the walls come down
One more heart in this waking town
We are the lights they forgot to count
Turn us up, we are coming out

[Intro]

[Verse 1]
My grandmother kept a little wooden radio
Beside the jar where she would save her change
The dial was loose, the cloth was torn and faded
But every Sunday brought a brighter range
She tapped her spoon against the kitchen table
And told me where a lonely song could start
Not in the gold that glitters in a window
But in the room you make inside your heart
We heard the rain come walking down the gutter
We heard the train complain beyond the mill
She turned them into something we could carry
A little hope that would not quite lie still

[Pre-Chorus]
I took that rhythm down the broken stairway
I took that lesson out beyond the door
The street was full of people needing someone
To tell them they were worth a little more

[Chorus 1]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Verse 2]
The storm came through and took the power with it
We found the old folks waiting in the heat
The drummer brought a van and filled it with water
The singer put a table on the street
We cooked whatever every house could offer
We shared the news and charged a neighbor's phone
That little radio ran on tired batteries
And nobody had to face the dark alone
I cannot tell you music fixes everything
Or makes the river turn its flood away
But I have seen a chorus hold a doorway
Until the frightened found a place to stay

[Chorus 2]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Some nights I think I hear her in the static
Still tapping out a beat beside the stove
She says a song is only worth the sharing
It finds its strength in every life it holds
So keep a little room beside your table
And leave a little fire against the cold
The tune we carry is a living promise
The more we give, the further it will go

[Final Chorus]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Outro]

inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
My grandmother kept a wooden radio
Beside the jar of pennies by the stove
She turned the dial and tapped the kitchen table
And made a little room for weary souls
The rain would keep its time along the gutter
The train would sing beyond the silent mill
She taught me songs were made for sharing
A little hope the night could not keep still

[Pre-Chorus]
I took that rhythm down the broken stairway
I took that lesson out beyond the door
The street was full of people needing someone
To tell them they were worth a little more

[Chorus 1]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Verse 2]
The storm came through and took the power with it
We found our older neighbors in the heat
The drummer brought a van of drinking water
The singer put a table on the street
We cooked what every house could offer
That old radio sang against the rain
A chorus cannot mend a broken city
But it can help us stand and build again

[Chorus 2]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Some nights I hear her in the static
Still tapping out a beat beside the stove
The song she gave was made for sharing
It finds its strength in every life it holds

[Final Chorus]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Outro]

inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The siren on the factory was silent
The river had gone black beneath the rain
We watched the bridge give way below the lanterns
And knew the road would never be the same
The foreman found a box of dusty drawings
The welder brought the helmet from his shed
The youngest held a light above our shoulders
And listened to the older voices thread
We measured every crack against the morning
We wrote the loads in chalk upon the wall
There was no easy speech to stop the weather
There were only hands enough to catch a fall

[Pre-Chorus]
A promise is a weight that we can carry
A warning is a truth that we must hear
We stop to check the work before we hurry
We hold each other steady through the fear

[Chorus 1]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Verse 2]
We raised the beams with numbers called in rhythm
We checked the bolts before the next one rose
The cook brought bread and set it by the shelter
The medic watched the cold inside our clothes
By midnight there was steel across the water
By sunrise there were footsteps on the span
A woman pushed her father's chair toward us
And smiled before the morning bus began
No statue stood to mark the ones who built it
No bright parade came marching through the rain
We packed the tools and walked beside each other
And heard the town begin to breathe again

[Chorus 2]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Twin Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
When all the easy answers turn to ashes
When every shining slogan loses weight
Remember every quiet hand beside you
Remember every person who will wait
We are no more than people making choices
We are no less than everything we try
The bridge is built from promises kept daily
And every honest spark beneath this sky

[Final Chorus]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, clear powerful clean gritty tenor, original melodic heavy metal and hard rock, 220.8 BPM E minor. Palm-muted twin guitars, audible driving bass, energetic double-kick accents, melodic lead guitar. Intelligible clean-sung lyrics, no growls or scat, dramatic prechorus and anthemic chorus. Instrumental twin-guitar solo, half-time bridge, complete final chorus and decisive band ending. Complete original 300-second song. Follow the supplied complete score and all the written lyrics. Clear lead singing forward in the mix over restrained accompaniment during every vocal line. Complete the final chorus before the instrumental ending.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The siren on the factory was silent
The river had gone black beneath the rain
We watched the bridge give way below the lanterns
And knew the road would never be the same
The foreman found a box of dusty drawings
The welder brought the helmet from his shed
We checked the loads and called each measured number
The youngest held a light above our heads

[Pre-Chorus]
A promise is a weight that we can carry
A warning is a truth that we must hear
We stop to check the work before we hurry
We hold each other steady through the fear

[Chorus 1]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Verse 2]
We raised the beams with numbers called in rhythm
We checked the bolts before the next one rose
The cook brought bread and set it by the shelter
The medic watched the cold inside our clothes
By midnight there was steel across the water
By sunrise there were footsteps on the span
A woman pushed her father's chair toward us
And smiled before the morning bus began

[Chorus 2]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Twin Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
When all the easy answers turn to ashes
When every shining slogan loses weight
Remember every quiet hand beside you
Remember every person who will wait

[Final Chorus]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: Japanese-language sung lead vocal, clear natural Japanese articulation, warm bright female alto, original Japanese light rock, 120.8 BPM D major. Clean jangly electric guitars, melodic bass, tight acoustic drums, gentle piano and subtle harmony on chorus endings. Sing the supplied Japanese words in order with clear morae, lyrical verses and memorable chorus, short guitar solo, tender bridge and a complete hopeful final cadence. Complete original 300-second song. Follow the supplied complete score and all the written lyrics. Clear lead singing forward in the mix over restrained accompaniment during every vocal line. Complete the final chorus before the instrumental ending.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
雨上がりの駅で　傘をたたんだ
見慣れたはずの街　少し変わった
古いパン屋の窓　灯りがともる
あの日と同じ匂い　風にまじる
忙しいふりして　返せなかった
短いメッセージ　何度も読んだ
会えばうまく話す　そう思うほど
胸の奥で言葉　小さくなる
ホームの時計だけ　先へ進んで
白い線の手前　靴をそろえた
聞き覚えのある声　名前を呼んだ
顔を上げたら君が　笑っていた

[Pre-Chorus]
変わらないものだけ　探していたけど
変わった君の声も　やさしかった
遅すぎることなど　きっとないよと
発車のベルよりも　近くで聞いた

[Chorus 1]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る
風にほどけてく　小さな迷い
言えなかった言葉　今は歌える
同じ空の下で　違う道を行く
それでも約束は　胸に残る
夕焼けのホームに　伸びるふたつの影
またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Verse 2]
商店街を抜けて　橋まで歩く
言葉のすきまには　川のひかり
君は新しい仕事　少し話した
私は失敗のこと　初めて言った
強くなったふりは　もういらないと
缶コーヒーの湯気が　空へほどける
写真の中だけに　残ると思った
つながりが今ここに　息をしてる
最終のひとつ前　電車が来れば
別々の窓から　夜を見るだろう
それでも帰り道　ひとりじゃないと
小さな切符の角　指でなぞった

[Chorus 2]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る
風にほどけてく　小さな迷い
言えなかった言葉　今は歌える
同じ空の下で　違う道を行く
それでも約束は　胸に残る
夕焼けのホームに　伸びるふたつの影
またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
返事を急がなくて　いい日もあるよ
弱さを隠さなくて　いい場所がある
季節が巡るたびに　違う私でも
君に会う約束を　忘れないよ

[Final Chorus]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る
夕焼けのホームに　伸びるふたつの影
またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, clear soulful alto, original syncopated funk song, 112 BPM D minor. Dry punchy drums, syncopated electric bass, clipped wah guitar, Rhodes piano, short brass responses. Crisp syllables sit in the groove, complete lyric-led verses and choruses, no scat or wordless substitute for the written vocal lines. A bass-and-drums break and a relaxed resolved ending. Complete original five-minute song with all written verses, choruses and bridge.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
I left my tired shoes beside the kitchen
The Friday train was running late again
You called me from the open corner window
And said the band was setting up at ten
The laundromat had folded up its tables
The flower seller pushed her cart aside
A drummer checked the echo in the alley
The bass came walking like a rolling tide
I carried all the week across my shoulders
And thought I had forgotten how to play
You smiled and held the doorway like an answer
The first good note took half the weight away

[Pre-Chorus]
You do not need a brand new pair of shoes
You do not need to hide a little bruise
Come as you are and let the evening start
The only thing we ask you for is heart

[Chorus 1]
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Take a little rhythm down the street
Let the bass line lift your heavy shoulders
Find the open space between the beats
Everybody brings a different story
Everybody gets a place to move
Turn the daily trouble into motion
Leave a little kindness in the groove
Pass it to the left, pass it to the right
Make a little room beneath the city light
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Let that good thing carry you tonight

[Verse 2]
The quiet man who fixes all our bicycles
Was teaching every kid a two-step turn
The nurse who takes the early Sunday shift here
Said joy was something people had to learn
A taxi rolled its windows to the music
The cook came out still wearing his white hat
We made a little space around a stranger

inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The bridge outside our town was painted yellow
The summer that I packed my life to go
I thought the world would give me better answers
Than any place that watched me learn to grow
I kept your letters folded in a suitcase
And read them when the city lost its shine
You wrote about the fence and changing weather
But never said the loneliness was mine
This morning I drove slowly past the water
The yellow paint had faded into gray
I saw you standing underneath the porch light
And all my clever speeches slipped away

[Pre-Chorus]
You took my bag and asked about the traffic
I asked if you had mended up the gate
We spoke of little things that meant the biggest
And let the harder words arrive too late

[Chorus 1]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Verse 2]
We found the toolbox underneath the stairway
The hammer still remembered how you worked
You showed me where the roof was letting rain in
I showed you how my telephone could work
At noon we ate the peaches you had bottled
The year you thought the orchard might not bloom
You laughed about the trouble I would get in
And all the empty chairs filled up the room
I used to think that staying meant surrender
I used to think that leaving made me strong
But love is in the ordinary mending
And learning where another heart belongs

[Chorus 2]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Fiddle Interlude]

[Bridge]
I cannot bring the missing Sundays with me
I cannot make the years run back upstream
But I can hold the ladder while you reach up
And help you plant the row you meant for spring
Tomorrow does not need a grand beginning
It needs two cups of coffee and some time
I am here to share the work of living
And let your tired hand rest next to mine

[Final Chorus]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, articulate soulful gritty baritone, original Black American roots rock with blues, rhythm and blues, and gospel-influenced harmony. 104 BPM E major, expressive overdriven electric guitar, Hammond organ, strong snare backbeat and rolling bass. Narrative lead vocal must sing all written words; backing responses support rather than replace it. Blues guitar solo, quiet bridge, broad final chorus and resolved ending. Complete original five-minute song with all written verses, choruses and bridge.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
My grandmother kept a little wooden radio
Beside the jar where she would save her change
The dial was loose, the cloth was torn and faded
But every Sunday brought a brighter range
She tapped her spoon against the kitchen table
And told me where a lonely song could start
Not in the gold that glitters in a window
But in the room you make inside your heart
We heard the rain come walking down the gutter
We heard the train complain beyond the mill
She turned them into something we could carry
A little hope that would not quite lie still

[Pre-Chorus]
I took that rhythm down the broken stairway
I took that lesson out beyond the door
The street was full of people needing someone
To tell them they were worth a little more

[Chorus 1]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Verse 2]
The storm came through and took the power with it
We found the old folks waiting in the heat
The drummer brought a van and filled it with water
The singer put a table on the street
We cooked whatever every house could offer
We shared the news and charged a neighbor's phone
That little radio ran on tired batteries
And nobody had to face the dark alone
I cannot tell you music fixes everything
Or makes the river turn its flood away
But I have seen a chorus hold a doorway
Until the frightened found a place to stay

[Chorus 2]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Some nights I think I hear her in the static
Still tapping out a beat beside the stove
She says a song is only worth the sharing
It finds its strength in every life it holds
So keep a little room beside your table
And leave a little fire against the cold
The tune we carry is a living promise
The more we give, the further it will go

[Final Chorus]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise
We can make a little shelter
From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

[Outro]

inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The siren on the factory was silent
The river had gone black beneath the rain
We watched the bridge give way below the lanterns
And knew the road would never be the same
The foreman found a box of dusty drawings
The welder brought the helmet from his shed
The youngest held a light above our shoulders
And listened to the older voices thread
We measured every crack against the morning
We wrote the loads in chalk upon the wall
There was no easy speech to stop the weather
There were only hands enough to catch a fall

[Pre-Chorus]
A promise is a weight that we can carry
A warning is a truth that we must hear
We stop to check the work before we hurry
We hold each other steady through the fear

[Chorus 1]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Verse 2]
We raised the beams with numbers called in rhythm
We checked the bolts before the next one rose
The cook brought bread and set it by the shelter
The medic watched the cold inside our clothes
By midnight there was steel across the water
By sunrise there were footsteps on the span
A woman pushed her father's chair toward us
And smiled before the morning bus began
No statue stood to mark the ones who built it
No bright parade came marching through the rain
We packed the tools and walked beside each other
And heard the town begin to breathe again

[Chorus 2]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Twin Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
When all the easy answers turn to ashes
When every shining slogan loses weight
Remember every quiet hand beside you
Remember every person who will wait
We are no more than people making choices
We are no less than everything we try
The bridge is built from promises kept daily
And every honest spark beneath this sky

[Final Chorus]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The elevator counted all the floors again
I watched my face dissolve against the door
A hundred little windows in the evening rain
A hundred lives I never asked about before
The woman with the flowers on the seventh floor
The boy who always carried home a cello case
The man who held the entry when my hands were full
I knew their coats, but not a single name or face
The hallway smelled of dinner and of drying paint
The notice board was full of things we meant to do
I passed it every evening like a stranger might
And kept my quiet room between myself and you

[Pre-Chorus]
Then every little screen went dark together
The fan fell still, the tower lost its hum
I heard a careful knock above the weather
And knew there was a place that I could come

[Chorus 1]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Verse 2]
We met upon the landing with a candle jar
The cello case was opened for a wooden chair
The woman from the seventh brought a thermos down
And asked if there was anybody needing care
We called across the courtyard with our torches raised
The lonely windows answered with a little white
We learned the names that lived behind the numbered doors
And stitched a map of voices through the broken light
The power came at midnight, humming back to life
But no one rushed to lock the evening out again
We wrote our names and numbers on the notice board
And left a chair for anyone who might come in

[Chorus 2]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
You do not have to tell your whole life story
You do not have to say that you are fine
The door can stay a little wider open
The silence does not have to be a wall this time
Tomorrow we will pass upon the staircase
The city will be rushing like before
But now I know the person in the doorway
And you know who is living one floor more

[Final Chorus]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Outro]

[Intro]

[Verse 1]
雨上がりの駅で　傘をたたんだ
見慣れたはずの街　少し変わった
古いパン屋の窓　灯りがともる
あの日と同じ匂い　風にまじる
忙しいふりして　返せなかった
短いメッセージ　何度も読んだ
会えばうまく話す　そう思うほど
胸の奥で言葉　小さくなる
ホームの時計だけ　先へ進んで
白い線の手前　靴をそろえた
聞き覚えのある声　名前を呼んだ
顔を上げたら君が　笑っていた

[Pre-Chorus]
変わらないものだけ　探していたけど
変わった君の声も　やさしかった
遅すぎることなど　きっとないよと
発車のベルよりも　近くで聞いた

[Chorus 1]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る
風にほどけてく　小さな迷い
言えなかった言葉　今は歌える
同じ空の下で　違う道を行く
それでも約束は　胸に残る
夕焼けのホームに　伸びるふたつの影
またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Verse 2]
商店街を抜けて　橋まで歩く
言葉のすきまには　川のひかり
君は新しい仕事　少し話した
私は失敗のこと　初めて言った
強くなったふりは　もういらないと
缶コーヒーの湯気が　空へほどける
写真の中だけに　残ると思った
つながりが今ここに　息をしてる
最終のひとつ前　電車が来れば
別々の窓から　夜を見るだろう
それでも帰り道　ひとりじゃないと
小さな切符の角　指でなぞった

[Chorus 2]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る
風にほどけてく　小さな迷い
言えなかった言葉　今は歌える

それでも約束は　胸に残る
夕焼けのホームに　伸びるふたつの影
またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
返事を急がなくて　いい日もあるよ
弱さを隠さなくて　いい場所がある
季節が巡るたびに　違う私でも
君に会う約束を　忘れないよ

[Final Chorus]
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
遠回りの日々も　ここにつながる
ポケットの切符は　明日のしるし
なくしたと思った　声が戻る

どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The velvet curtain smelled of rain and timber
The ticket window held a paper moon
A cleaner hummed beneath the broken chandelier
While someone tried to bring the keys in tune
The carpenter had brought his little daughter
She asked if all the stars had gone away
He pointed to the lamps above the balcony
And said that they were waiting for today

[Pre-Chorus]
Who says the bright days only live behind us
Who says the door is closed because it fell
One hand can lift a lantern for another
One voice can wake the room we know so well

[Chorus 1]
Raise the roof and let the daylight in
Let the smallest voice begin again
We have come through weather, dust and doubt
Now the room is full, so sing it out
Take your place beside the open door
There is room for you and room for more
When the final chord has found its home
No one leaves this room alone

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English sung lead vocal, expressive theatrical tenor with original vocal tone, huge multi-layer choir backing vocals and call-and-response. inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
I built a little theatre in the rain
With paper stars and windows for a frame
The street became a sea of silver light
We raised the painted curtain to the night
A nervous heart can learn a mighty sound
When all the other voices gather round
I left my fear beside the empty chair
And found a hundred answers in the air

[Pre-Chorus]
Raise the curtain, hold the light
Let the rooftops sing tonight
From a whisper to a choir
We can build a rising fire

[Chorus 1]
We light the room, we lift the sky
We let the sleeping colors fly
A thousand voices, one refrain
A little sun against the rain
We light the room, we lift the sky
We keep the smallest dreams alive
Across the dark, across the blue
The stage is waiting here for you

[Verse 2]
The velvet sky was torn along the seam
We sewed it with the colors of a dream
A humble tune can fill a mighty hall
If every lonely voice can hear the call
No perfect crown and no immortal name
Just living hearts that share a little flame
The city has a thousand songs to spare
And every one can find a welcome there

[Chorus 2]
We light the room, we lift the sky
We let the sleeping colors fly
A thousand voices, one refrain
A little sun against the rain
We light the room, we lift the sky
We keep the smallest dreams alive
Across the dark, across the blue
The stage is waiting here for you

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
One voice calling, two replying
Three small sparks can fill the sky
All together, slowly rising
Let the hidden colors fly

[Final Chorus]
We light the room, we lift the sky
We let the sleeping colors fly
A thousand voices, one refrain
A little sun against the rain
We light the room, we lift the sky
We keep the smallest dreams alive
Across the dark, across the blue
The stage is waiting here for you

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English sung lead vocal, clear energetic slightly gritty voice with layered chorus harmony. Electronic rock, 136 BPM E minor, pulsing analogue sequencer, distorted rhythm guitars, gritty bass synth doubled with electric bass, live drums reinforced by electronic kick, filtered breakdown, wide final refrain, tight rhythmic ending. inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The signal wakes beneath the street
A silver rhythm at my feet
The windows flicker into day
We send a little light away
A guitar cuts across the grid
And finds the things the silence hid
No map can tell us where to go
We follow what the speakers know

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up and let it breathe
Hear the heartbeat underneath
From the rooftops to the floor
We are opening the door

[Chorus 1]
Run with the electric dawn
Keep the little signal on
Through the city, through the blue
Let the light come running through
Run with the electric dawn
All the lonely nights are gone
When the bass line starts to rise
We can see another sky

[Verse 2]
The wires hum a second sky
The traffic draws an answer by
We turn the static into rain
And wash the dust out of the frame
The circuit opens like a flower
A thousand sparks become an hour
Our shadows move across the screen
And leave a space for what we dream

[Chorus 2]
Run with the electric dawn
Keep the little signal on
Through the city, through the blue
Let the light come running through
Run with the electric dawn
All the lonely nights are gone
When the bass line starts to rise
We can see another sky

[Instrumental Solo]

[Bridge]
Drop the noise and hear the room
Let the quiet start to bloom
Then a pulse becomes a wave
Every heart has light to save

[Final Chorus]
Run with the electric dawn
Keep the little signal on
Through the city, through the blue
Let the light come running through
Run with the electric dawn
All the lonely nights are gone
When the bass line starts to rise
We can see another sky

[Outro]

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, clear soulful alto, original syncopated funk song, 112 BPM D minor. Dry punchy drums, syncopated electric bass, clipped wah guitar, Rhodes piano, short brass responses. Crisp syllables sit in the groove, complete lyric-led verses and choruses, no scat or wordless substitute for the written vocal lines. A bass-and-drums break and a relaxed resolved ending. Complete five-minute (300-second) original song. Target form: Intro 0-17s, Verse 1 17-69s, Pre-Chorus 69-86s, Chorus 1 86-120s, Verse 2 120-171s, Chorus 2 171-206s, Bass Break 206-231s, Bridge 231-249s, Final Chorus 249-283s, Outro 283-300s. Lyrics begin after the brief instrumental introduction. Keep enough musical space to sing all written verses and chorus returns. Finish the final chorus before the instrumental ending.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
I left my tired shoes beside the kitchen
The Friday train was running late again
You called me from the open corner window
And said the band was setting up at ten
The laundromat had folded up its tables
The flower seller pushed her cart aside
A drummer checked the echo in the alley
The bass came walking like a rolling tide
I carried all the week across my shoulders
And thought I had forgotten how to play
You smiled and held the doorway like an answer
The first good note took half the weight away

[Pre-Chorus]
You do not need a brand new pair of shoes
You do not need to hide a little bruise
Come as you are and let the evening start
The only thing we ask you for is heart

[Chorus 1]
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Take a little rhythm down the street
Let the bass line lift your heavy shoulders
Find the open space between the beats
Everybody brings a different story
Everybody gets a place to move
Turn the daily trouble into motion
Leave a little kindness in the groove
Pass it to the left, pass it to the right
Make a little room beneath the city light
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Let that good thing carry you tonight

[Verse 2]
The quiet man who fixes all our bicycles
Was teaching every kid a two-step turn
The nurse who takes the early Sunday shift here
Said joy was something people had to learn
A taxi rolled its windows to the music
The cook came out still wearing his white hat
We made a little space around a stranger
And nobody asked where the stranger sat
The moon was like a coin above the rooftops
But nobody was counting what we spent
We gave away the minutes we were saving
And got them back with every smile we sent

[Chorus 2]
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Take a little rhythm down the street
Let the bass line lift your heavy shoulders
Find the open space between the beats
Everybody brings a different story
Everybody gets a place to move
Turn the daily trouble into motion
Leave a little kindness in the groove
Pass it to the left, pass it to the right
Make a little room beneath the city light
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Let that good thing carry you tonight

[Bass Break]

[Bridge]
When Monday comes and tries to steal the color
Remember how the whole block found its feet
Keep one small spark to pass on to another
Keep one warm word for someone on your street
The good we make is never going missing
It travels in the little things we do
So take this beat wherever you are heading
And leave the door as open as we do

[Final Chorus]
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Take a little rhythm down the street
Let the bass line lift your heavy shoulders
Find the open space between the beats
Everybody brings a different story
Everybody gets a place to move
Turn the daily trouble into motion
Leave a little kindness in the groove
Pass it to the left, pass it to the right
Make a little room beneath the city light
Put a little daylight in your pocket
Let that good thing carry you tonight

[Outro]

inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, intimate articulate warm baritone, original country folk ballad, 88 BPM G major. Fingerpicked steel-string guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, restrained pedal steel and fiddle, natural unhurried diction. Lead vocal clearly sings the supplied complete verses and chorus. inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The bridge outside our town was painted yellow
The summer that I packed my life to go
I thought the world would give me better answers
Than any place that watched me learn to grow
I kept your letters folded in a suitcase
And read them when the city lost its shine
You wrote about the fence and changing weather
But never said the loneliness was mine
This morning I drove slowly past the water
The yellow paint had faded into gray
I saw you standing underneath the porch light
And all my clever speeches slipped away

[Pre-Chorus]
You took my bag and asked about the traffic
I asked if you had mended up the gate
We spoke of little things that meant the biggest
And let the harder words arrive too late

[Chorus 1]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Verse 2]
We found the toolbox underneath the stairway
The hammer still remembered how you worked
You showed me where the roof was letting rain in
I showed you how my telephone could work
At noon we ate the peaches you had bottled
The year you thought the orchard might not bloom
You laughed about the trouble I would get in
And all the empty chairs filled up the room
I used to think that staying meant surrender
I used to think that leaving made me strong
But love is in the ordinary mending
And learning where another heart belongs

[Chorus 2]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Fiddle Interlude]

[Bridge]
I cannot bring the missing Sundays with me
I cannot make the years run back upstream
But I can hold the ladder while you reach up
And help you plant the row you meant for spring
Tomorrow does not need a grand beginning
It needs two cups of coffee and some time
I am here to share the work of living
And let your tired hand rest next to mine

[Final Chorus]
Leave a light beside the kitchen window
Leave a chair where I can rest my bones
Every mile has taught me something different
Every road has led me closer home
I have chased a thousand distant mornings
I have watched the wild and restless sky
But the place that holds the best of who I am
Is the place that never asked me why
Set the kettle singing in the silence
Let the old screen door swing open wide
I am bringing all my years of wandering
And a little more forgiveness back inside

[Outro]

My grandmother kept a little wooden radio
Beside the jar where she would save her change
The dial was loose, the cloth was torn and faded

She tapped her spoon against the kitchen table

Not in the gold that glitters in a window

We heard the rain come walking down the gutter
We heard the train complain beyond the mill
She turned them into something we could carry

[Chorus 1]

There is a fire in the open hand

That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway

From the thunder in our lives
Let the old guitar keep talking
Let the organ answer true
There is a river in the backbeat
And it carries me to you

We found the old folks waiting in the heat
The drummer brought a van and filled it with water

That little radio ran on tired batteries
And nobody had to face the dark alone

There is a river in the backbeat

And it carries me to you

She says a song is only worth the sharing
It finds its strength in every life it holds

And leave a little fire against the cold
The tune we carry is a living promise
The more we give, the further it will go

[Final Chorus]
There is a river in the backbeat
There is a fire in the open hand
There is a road beneath our singing
That no hard season can divide
Bring your sorrow to the doorway
Bring your joy and let it rise

And it carries me to you

[Outro]

The river had gone black beneath the rain

And knew the road would never be the same

The welder brought the helmet from his shed
The youngest held a light above our shoulders
And listened to the older voices thread

We wrote the loads in chalk upon the wall
There was no easy speech to stop the weather

A promise is a weight that we can carry
A warning is a truth that we must hear

[Chorus 1]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We hold the line with our eyes wide open
Hammer the dark till the daylight rings
Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings
No borrowed crown and no empty glory
We write the ending to our own story
One more breath and another try
Raise your voice to the iron sky
Hands to the work, let the sparks run free
Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

[Verse 2]
We raised the beams with numbers called in rhythm
We checked the bolts before the next one rose
The cook brought bread and set it by the shelter
The medic watched the cold inside our clothes

By sunrise there were footsteps on the span
A woman pushed her father's chair toward us
And smiled before the morning bus began
No statue stood to mark the ones who built it
No bright parade came marching through the rain
We packed the tools and walked beside each other
And heard the town begin to breathe again

Stand on the ground that tomorrow brings

Build what the frightened thought could never be
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken
We are the promise that stays unspoken

When every shining slogan loses weight
Remember every quiet hand beside you
Remember every person who will wait
We are no more than people making choices
We are no less than everything we try
The bridge is built from promises kept daily
And every honest spark beneath this sky

[Final Chorus]
We bend, we burn, but we are not broken

Hammer the dark till the daylight rings

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The elevator counted all the floors again
I watched my face dissolve against the door
A hundred little windows in the evening rain
A hundred lives I never asked about before
The woman with the flowers on the seventh floor
The boy who always carried home a cello case
The man who held the entry when my hands were full
I knew their coats, but not a single name or face
The hallway smelled of dinner and of drying paint
The notice board was full of things we meant to do
I passed it every evening like a stranger might
And kept my quiet room between myself and you

[Pre-Chorus]
Then every little screen went dark together
The fan fell still, the tower lost its hum
I heard a careful knock above the weather
And knew there was a place that I could come

[Chorus 1]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Verse 2]
We met upon the landing with a candle jar
The cello case was opened for a wooden chair
The woman from the seventh brought a thermos down
And asked if there was anybody needing care
We called across the courtyard with our torches raised
The lonely windows answered with a little white
We learned the names that lived behind the numbered doors
And stitched a map of voices through the broken light
The power came at midnight, humming back to life
But no one rushed to lock the evening out again
We wrote our names and numbers on the notice board
And left a chair for anyone who might come in

[Chorus 2]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
You do not have to tell your whole life story
You do not have to say that you are fine
The door can stay a little wider open
The silence does not have to be a wall this time
Tomorrow we will pass upon the staircase
The city will be rushing like before
But now I know the person in the doorway
And you know who is living one floor more

[Final Chorus]
Send a signal through the concrete
Leave a light above the stairs
Someone in the tower is listening
Someone knows that you are there
We are more than passing shadows
More than numbers on a screen
Keep the line alive between us
Keep a little space to breathe
If the city turns to static
If the morning loses blue
Send a signal through the concrete
I will send one back to you

[Outro]

強くなったふりは　もういらないと
缶コーヒーの湯気が　空へほどける
写真の中だけに　残ると思った
つながりが今ここに　息をしてる
最終のひとつ前　電車が来れば

改札の向こうで　君が手を振る

またねと笑ったら　歩き出せる
改札の向こうで　君が手を振る
どこにいてもきっと　歌は届く

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
返事を急がなくて　いい日もあるよ
弱さを隠さなくて　いい場所がある
季節が巡るたびに　違う私でも
君に会う約束を　忘れないよ

改札の向こうで　君が手を振る

inputs.label: 风格指令
inputs.description: English-language sung lead vocal, articulate expressive theatrical tenor with original stacked ensemble harmonies, original theatrical glam and arena rock, 96 BPM B-flat major. Grand piano, melodic electric bass, acoustic drums, harmonized electric guitar, dramatic quiet-to-loud changes, rich choir-like backing in choruses. Sing complete supplied lyrics clearly; no artist voice imitation and no borrowed song melody. Piano-led bridge, guitar solo, grand final chorus and resolved ending. Complete five-minute (300-second) original song. Target form: Intro 0-20s, Verse 1 20-60s, Pre-Chorus 60-80s, Chorus 1 80-120s, Verse 2 120-160s, Chorus 2 160-200s, Guitar Solo 200-230s, Bridge 230-250s, Final Chorus 250-290s, Outro 290-300s. Lyrics begin after the brief instrumental introduction. Keep enough musical space to sing all written verses and chorus returns. Finish the final chorus before the instrumental ending.

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The velvet curtain smelled of rain and timber
The ticket window held a paper moon
A cleaner hummed beneath the broken chandelier
While someone tried to bring the keys in tune
The carpenter had brought his little daughter
She asked if all the stars had gone away
He pointed to the lamps above the balcony
And said that they were waiting for today
We swept the aisles and found a dozen programs
From nights when every seat had held a dream
The names were fading softly on the covers
But every empty stage could hear them sing

[Pre-Chorus]
Who says the bright days only live behind us
Who says the door is closed because it fell
One hand can lift a lantern for another
One voice can wake the room we know so well

[Chorus 1]
Raise the roof and let the daylight in
Let the smallest voice begin again
We have come through weather, dust and doubt
Now the room is full, so sing it out
Every cracked and ordinary heart
Has a note that makes the whole thing start
Take your place beside the open door
There is room for you and room for more
Raise the roof, let every window shine
Make this borrowed moment yours and mine
When the final chord has found its home
No one leaves this room alone

[Verse 2]
At seven there were people on the pavement
At eight the little foyer filled with light
The tailor wore the jacket he had mended
The drummer's mother took the seat on right
The cleaner stood beside the wings and listened
The child was counting stars above the stage
We sang about the ordinary miracles
That never made the front of any page
No golden throne was waiting in the spotlight
No single crown belonged above the rest
The loudest cheer was for the quiet people
Who built the place where everyone was blessed

[Chorus 2]
Raise the roof and let the daylight in
Let the smallest voice begin again
We have come through weather, dust and doubt
Now the room is full, so sing it out
Every cracked and ordinary heart
Has a note that makes the whole thing start
Take your place beside the open door
There is room for you and room for more
Raise the roof, let every window shine
Make this borrowed moment yours and mine
When the final chord has found its home
No one leaves this room alone

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
And when the rented lights are going dark
And when the tired seats are folded down
The song will travel home in every heart
And find another doorway in the town
There is no need to wait for perfect weather
There is no need to wear a borrowed name
We make a place by standing here together
And every little voice can feed the flame

[Final Chorus]
Raise the roof and let the daylight in
Let the smallest voice begin again
We have come through weather, dust and doubt
Now the room is full, so sing it out
Every cracked and ordinary heart
Has a note that makes the whole thing start
Take your place beside the open door
There is room for you and room for more
Raise the roof, let every window shine
Make this borrowed moment yours and mine
When the final chord has found its home
No one leaves this room alone

[Outro]

inputs.label: 完整歌词
inputs.description:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
The phone lit up before the sky had color
Another hundred things I had to know
I watched the morning vanish into windows
That showed me everywhere I could not go
You left a cup beside the quiet doorway
And asked if I could walk a little way
I said there was a message I should answer
And watched another hour become a day
At dusk the room was full of other voices
But none of them could hear me when I spoke
I found your note beneath the cooling kettle
And felt the little spell around me broke

[Pre-Chorus]
I put the shining screen against the table
I let the endless river pass me by
I heard the traffic breathing through the window
And found a piece of morning in your eyes

[Chorus 1]
Pull me out of the flashing numbers
Bring me back to the room we share
I can hear your voice beneath the thunder
I can feel a heartbeat there
Cut the noise and keep the signal
Let the real world start to shine
We are more than a passing image
More than a moving line
Put your hand beside the window
Watch the morning touch the glass
We can build a slower kind of future
We can make this moment last

[Verse 2]
We walked beside the shops that still were closing
The people looked like people once again
A stranger asked the way toward the station
We stopped and drew a map beside the rain
You told me of the garden you were planting
I told you of a fear I could not name
There was no button I could use to fix it
But saying it had changed the weight it made
We watched the last bus turn around the corner
We let the evening have its ordinary sound
The world was not a stream I had to finish
It was the steady earth beneath the ground

[Chorus 2]
Pull me out of the flashing numbers
Bring me back to the room we share
I can hear your voice beneath the thunder
I can feel a heartbeat there
Cut the noise and keep the signal
Let the real world start to shine
We are more than a passing image
More than a moving line
Put your hand beside the window
Watch the morning touch the glass
We can build a slower kind of future
We can make this moment last

[Electronic Instrumental]

[Bridge]
Tomorrow there will still be things to answer
Tomorrow there will still be work to do
But now I know a signal worth receiving
The quiet kind that brings me back to you
I will not let the endless spinning pictures
Decide how much a living moment means
Leave room for breath and room for one another
And room for all the life between the screens

[Final Chorus]
Pull me out of the flashing numbers
Bring me back to the room we share
I can hear your voice beneath the thunder
I can feel a heartbeat there
Cut the noise and keep the signal
Let the real world start to shine
We are more than a passing image

A complete forty-eight-second acoustic chamber miniature for a refined paper-and-perfume holiday commercial. 90 BPM, four-four, D major with brief B minor colour. Establish a steady light eighth-note pulse from the FIRST beat: close dry pizzicato strings, short warm piano notes, round plucked double bass, soft brushed snare and tiny wooden clicks. Clear short transients every roughly one-third second, understated syncopation, small acoustic room, a witty restrained two-bar melody. No long ambient introduction. First eight seconds immediately nimble; eight to twelve seconds briefly thin the melody for photographic detail; twelve to seventeen seconds a rising short phrase; seventeen to twenty-eight seconds continuous rhythmic walking pulse with fewer melodic notes; twenty-eight to thirty-five seconds piano answers the typing rhythm; thirty-five to forty-three seconds a small staccato lift; final five seconds resolve gently, ending with one short piano cadence and a clean natural decay. No voice, singing, choir, epic strings, electronic bass drop or huge impact. The pulse stays readable without becoming a loud dance beat.

inputs.label: 提示词
inputs.description:
<Subject1> 是 <Picture 1> 画面中央悬浮正面朝向镜头前下方的圣光机甲天使：纯白鎏金磨损机甲，头顶悬浮金色光环，背后展开巨大的白金色羽翼，羽翼边缘泛着金光，右手握持鎏金圣剑，剑刃带着圣光辉光。保留参考图中的面部机甲造型、光环、羽翼、圣剑、机甲配色、身材比例以及整体厚涂油画质感外貌。<Subject1> 全片无台词，只有低沉的机械轰鸣与神圣的低吟声。

<Subject2> 是暗翼机甲恶魔：全身覆盖哑光黑甲，面部被牛角头盔完全遮盖，背后展开两对暗紫色骨翼，手持漆黑暗影战刃，悬浮在空中。他不在参考图中，全片身形与装束不变；他是强敌，出手迅猛狠戾，只有沙哑的机械嘶吼声。

<Subject3> 是高空云海天界战场场景。

人物站位：正午，万道圣光从云层顶端倾泻而下，金色圣光粒子、白色羽毛碎屑在空中飞舞。<Subject1> 悬浮在云海上方的半空中，位于画面中央，正面朝向镜头前下方，视线望向远方的恶魔；左侧白羽与右侧鎏金光羽被风扯向画面右后方；鎏金圣剑由右手握持，剑刃斜向下指，萦绕着细碎金光。<Subject2> 悬浮在他前方的暗云里，此刻尚未完全现身。画面左侧立着一块残破的刻文石碑，周围是翻涌的米白色云海。画面无可读文字，不出现参考图上下的黑边。

【状态锁定】
悬浮：0-15.0秒，圣光机甲天使全程悬浮在云海上方，暗翼机甲恶魔全程悬浮在空中；两人从不落地、不下坠，始终保持悬空状态。
阶段一，0-7.5秒：没有天象大招，两人本体悬空交锋。
阶段二，7.5-9.5秒：天象大招成形——头顶云层翻涌化作金色圣光海，万道圣光从云层向下劈落，两人仍保持悬空状态。
阶段三，9.5-15.0秒：本体原地施法出招，圣光海持续压向恶魔，全程伴随圣光粒子倾泻。圣光海从7.5秒成形后一直存在，直到终结技后才缓缓消散，中途不消失、不与本体合并。

【全局前置设定（画质与质感）】
摄影增强版参数包：高端写实 3D Anime Cinematic、Photorealistic Game CG，UE5.4 Path Tracing，顶级院线动作摄影质感。PBR 物理材质，纯白鎏金机甲的磨损划痕金属反射、羽翼的羽毛纤维纹理、金色光环的辉光散射、圣剑的冷冽金属光泽、黑甲的哑光质感精密还原。电影级 ACES 高动态范围、自然高光滚降、真实镜头曝光、细腻景深、体积光、圣光粒子层、云海反射与空气透视；保留原图厚涂油画笔触，画面锐利但不塑料，黑位有层次，亮部不溢出，机甲与羽翼绝不糊成一块。
整体定位：天界战场圣光机甲天使大战暗翼恶魔，写实电影感 CG，圣光普照、厚重油画质感的神圣史诗氛围。两人有来有回：每一次出手都有当场的应对与反击，暗翼恶魔前半段两度占上风，圣光天使直到最后一记才赢下。
特效体系：亮金圣光剑痕 对 深紫暗影刃 + 厚涂油画笔触 + 圣光粒子、羽毛碎屑、云浪碎末

【运镜规格】
全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、冻结、静止机位、拖沓慢动作。35mm 手持跟拍/电影镜头，全程1.0-1.5Hz高频呼吸微抖，0.08s极低惯性延迟，动态快门1/2000s。摄影机像被角色牵引而非旁观，每次加速、减速、转向都由天使、恶魔或圣光海的力量触发。人物机甲面部、握圣剑的手、圣剑剑刃、圣光剑痕优先保持清晰，背景允许速度拖影；光刃高速经过镜头时产生极短失焦再立即锁焦。人物朝向严格以每一拍写明的为准：写背对镜头就只拍背影，写侧对镜头就只露侧脸，不许自行转身正面对着镜头。

[Shot 1]
0-1.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】0帧画面与参考图完全一致——纯白鎏金机甲天使悬浮在云海高空，金色光环在头顶，双翼展开，右手持圣剑，圣光从上方倾泻而下，左侧立着残破的刻文石碑；0.3秒前方暗云里一道深紫暗影刃横劈而来，刃风过处云海被劈开一道长沟，溅起暗紫色光屑；天使抬圣剑横挡，亮金与深紫两色火花在他身前炸开，暗影刃被拦腰斩散。运镜：镜头贴着云海在天使前方倒退，暗影刃劈来时镜头朝那个方向猛地一甩，画面轻轻一震，金紫两色光尘与羽毛碎屑扑向镜头。
1.5-3.0秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】暗翼恶魔从暗云中冲出，两人相向悬空冲锋，天使转为侧对镜头，面朝画面左侧的恶魔；恶魔举暗影战刃自上而下劈落，天使举圣剑横架，刃剑相交处炸开金紫两色火花，两人同时被震得向后倒飞数米，仍稳稳悬浮在空中。运镜：镜头横移到两人之间的侧面，跟着暗影战刃劈下的方向猛地一压，焦点从暗刃切到被压弯的圣剑剑刃，画面轻轻一震，火花沿刃剑交界处成串迸射。
3.0-4.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】天使借倒飞的惯性旋身，圣剑侧面的剑脊狠狠撞在恶魔胸口的暗水晶护甲上，那里崩出一个裂隙，深紫光屑从裂隙里溅出；恶魔顺势拍动暗翼卸力，两人擦身而过、交换位置，天使仍侧对镜头。运镜：镜头绕着交错的两人转半圈，焦点从圣剑剑脊切到恶魔胸口崩开的裂隙，画面轻轻一震，金色光尘与深紫光屑一起飞溅。
4.5-6.0秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】恶魔拍动四对暗翼，甩出数十道暗影飞刃，同时抬手在天使脚下召出深紫深渊法阵，法阵爆发的冲击波正撞在天使的机甲护腿上，把他掀退十余米，天使被撞得背对镜头，右侧的鎏金光羽被暗风掀得猎猎翻卷，数根白羽被削落。运镜：镜头在天使身后，跟着他倒滑向后弹开，拍他的背影和迎面扑来的暗影飞刃，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，云浪碎末与深紫光片炸满画面。
6.0-7.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】恶魔乘势挥刃连劈三刀，第三刀劈在天使身侧的云海中，炸起数十米高的暗紫色水浪；天使被震得压低下身，以圣剑拄着下方的云海撑住，侧对镜头，肩甲被暗刃划出一道划痕，头顶的金光环却骤然亮了数倍。运镜：水浪炸起时镜头向后弹开，再从上往下俯拍他压低下身的侧影，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，云海裂开、圣光粒子炸起。
7.5-9.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·天象大招成形】天使抬手举圣剑向天，头顶的金光环爆发出刺眼金光，头顶厚重的云层骤然翻涌，化作一片金色的圣光海，万道碗口粗的圣光从圣光海中向下劈落，所过之处暗云瞬间消散；几乎同时，恶魔也召出一片暗紫色的雷云，与金色圣光海在高空对峙。两人侧对镜头悬空对峙，左侧的残破刻文石碑在气浪中纹丝不动。运镜：镜头被气浪推着急速后拉、拔高到数里外的超远视角，两人本体缩成云海上方一明一暗两个小点，再缓缓推回两者之间。
9.5-12.0秒：【状态：天象大招对战·本体悬空同步】金色圣光海侧对镜头，面朝暗紫色雷云。恶魔先动，暗雷云劈出数十道紫雷，恶魔本体同步挥出一道巨大的暗影刃；天使侧身让过紫雷，暗刃擦着他的肩甲冲过，撕下一大片鎏金机甲碎块，碎块坠进云海炸成一片金光；天使借侧身之势把圣剑举到最高，身后的羽翼同时展开射出数百道金色光刃，圣光海同步翻涌出数道金色巨浪压向恶魔。运镜：镜头在两者之间横移，暗刃冲过时镜头被气浪撞得向后一仰，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，金光、云浪与深紫光屑在两侧翻涌。

【禁止项】

文字/UI/水印/Logo/角标/可读文字/真实UI

【强制声明】

无背景音乐,仅保留环境音与人声和音效;画面禁字幕/文字/水印/Logo;禁止可读文字(指画面字幕文字,不含人声台词)

<Subject2> 是暗翼机甲恶魔：全身覆盖哑光黑甲，面部被牛角头盔完全遮盖，背后展开两对暗紫色骨翼，手持漆黑暗影战刃，悬浮在空中。他不在参考图中，全片身形与装束不变；他是强敌，出手迅猛狠戾，只有沙哑的机械嘶吼声。

<Subject3> 是高空云海天界战场场景。

人物站位：正午，万道圣光从云层顶端倾泻而下，金色圣光粒子、白色羽毛碎屑在空中飞舞。<Subject1> 悬浮在云海上方的半空中，位于画面中央，正面朝向镜头前下方，视线望向远方的恶魔；左侧白羽与右侧鎏金光羽被风扯向画面右后方；鎏金圣剑由右手握持，剑刃斜向下指，萦绕着细碎金光。<Subject2> 悬浮在他前方的暗云里，此刻尚未完全现身。画面左侧立着一块残破的刻文石碑，周围是翻涌的米白色云海。画面无可读文字，不出现参考图上下的黑边。

【状态锁定】
悬浮：0-15.0秒，圣光机甲天使全程悬浮在云海上方，暗翼机甲恶魔全程悬浮在空中；两人从不落地、不下坠，始终保持悬空状态。
阶段一，0-7.5秒：没有天象大招，两人本体悬空交锋。
阶段二，7.5-9.5秒：天象大招成形——头顶云层翻涌化作金色圣光海，万道圣光从云层向下劈落，两人仍保持悬空状态。
阶段三，9.5-15.0秒：本体原地施法出招，圣光海持续压向恶魔，全程伴随圣光粒子倾泻。圣光海从7.5秒成形后一直存在，直到终结技后才缓缓消散，中途不消失、不与本体合并。

【全局前置设定（画质与质感）】
摄影增强版参数包：高端写实 3D Anime Cinematic、Photorealistic Game CG，UE5.4 Path Tracing，顶级院线动作摄影质感。PBR 物理材质，纯白鎏金机甲的磨损划痕金属反射、羽翼的羽毛纤维纹理、金色光环的辉光散射、圣剑的冷冽金属光泽、黑甲的哑光质感精密还原。电影级 ACES 高动态范围、自然高光滚降、真实镜头曝光、细腻景深、体积光、圣光粒子层、云海反射与空气透视；保留原图厚涂油画笔触，画面锐利但不塑料，黑位有层次，亮部不溢出，机甲与羽翼绝不糊成一块。
整体定位：天界战场圣光机甲天使大战暗翼恶魔，写实电影感 CG，圣光普照、厚重油画质感的神圣史诗氛围。两人有来有回：每一次出手都有当场的应对与反击，暗翼恶魔前半段两度占上风，圣光天使直到最后一记才赢下。
特效体系：亮金圣光剑痕 对 深紫暗影刃 + 厚涂油画笔触 + 圣光粒子、羽毛碎屑、云浪碎末

12.0-15.0秒：【状态：天象大招对战·本体悬空同步·终结技】天使与头顶的圣光海同时发动——圣剑挥出一道横贯云海的金色光刃，正正劈进恶魔胸口先前那个裂隙；擦身交错的一瞬，画面闪了一帧纯白，所有声音被抽空；再出现时，天使已悬浮在恶魔身后数步，背对恶魔、正面朝向镜头，圣剑斜拖在身侧。半拍之后，天使肩甲的碎金屑缓缓飘落；恶魔胸口的裂隙才彻底崩裂，整个人化作漫天深紫光屑，暗雷云也随之消散，冲击波由近到远一路扫过云海，左侧的残破刻文石碑在冲击中猎猎作响但未倒，圣光海缓缓化作金色光点散去。天使侧过半张机甲脸，最后半秒姿态精准定格——斜拖的圣剑、扬起的白羽、头顶的金光环、漫天的金光与紫屑全部静止。定格全片只此一次。运镜：镜头在天使身前缓缓后退，冲击波到达时画面剧烈晃动、整个画面被亮金的光闪白了三下、画面发晕，随即稳在他身前的中景，最后半秒画面完全定住不动，定格前一刻画面轻轻一震（圣剑微颤）。

【负面提示词】
严禁硬切镜头，多机位剪辑，黑屏转场，空镜头，生硬转场
严禁任何血液、伤口、断肢，所有受击全程由金色光尘、暗紫光屑、机甲碎甲、羽毛碎屑表现。严禁任何血液、伤口、断肢，所有受击全程由金色光尘、暗紫光屑、机甲碎甲、羽毛碎屑表现。
严禁过度运动模糊，糊脸，融图糊成一团；严禁逆光过曝糊成一片，严禁画面丢失黑位与层次
严禁出现字幕，水印，文字，台词，对话，诗词；严禁出现参考图上下的黑边
严控手指与手部结构（握剑、抬臂、挥剑精准，严防多指畸形），严防白羽、鎏金光羽、机甲高速运动穿模
严禁任何人物中途落地、下坠或凭空换成站立状态；严禁圣光海在7.5秒前出现、在9.5秒后消失或与本体合并
严禁任何一方站着不动挨打，每一次出手都要有当场的应对与反击；严禁人物无故转身正面对着镜头，人物朝向以每一拍写明的为准
严禁出现第三个角色；严禁残破刻文石碑在同一镜头内位置漂移或凭空生长

【禁止项】

文字/UI/水印/Logo/角标/可读文字/真实UI

【强制声明】

无背景音乐,仅保留环境音与人声和音效;画面禁字幕/文字/水印/Logo;禁止可读文字(指画面字幕文字,不含人声台词)

inputs.label: 提示词
inputs.description:
<Subject1> 是 <Picture 1> 画面中央悬浮正面朝向镜头前下方的圣光机甲天使：纯白鎏金磨损机甲，头顶悬浮金色光环，背后展开巨大的白金色羽翼，羽翼边缘泛着金光，右手握持鎏金圣剑，剑刃带着圣光辉光。保留参考图中的面部机甲造型、光环、羽翼、圣剑、机甲配色、身材比例以及整体厚涂油画质感外貌。<Subject1> 全片无台词，只有低沉的机械轰鸣与神圣的低吟声。

<Subject2> 是暗翼机甲恶魔：全身覆盖哑光黑甲，面部被牛角头盔完全遮盖，背后展开两对暗紫色骨翼，手持漆黑暗影战刃，悬浮在空中。他不在参考图中，全片身形与装束不变；他是强敌，出手迅猛狠戾，只有沙哑的机械嘶吼声。

<Subject3> 是高空云海天界战场场景。

人物站位：正午，万道圣光从云层顶端倾泻而下，金色圣光粒子、白色羽毛碎屑在空中飞舞。<Subject1> 悬浮在云海上方的半空中，位于画面中央，正面朝向镜头前下方，视线望向远方的恶魔；左侧白羽与右侧鎏金光羽被风扯向画面右后方；鎏金圣剑由右手握持，剑刃斜向下指，萦绕着细碎金光。<Subject2> 悬浮在他前方的暗云里，此刻尚未完全现身。画面左侧立着一块残破的刻文石碑，周围是翻涌的米白色云海。画面无可读文字，不出现参考图上下的黑边。

【状态锁定】
悬浮：0-15.0秒，圣光机甲天使全程悬浮在云海上方，暗翼机甲恶魔全程悬浮在空中；两人从不落地、不下坠，始终保持悬空状态。
阶段一，0-7.5秒：没有天象大招，两人本体悬空交锋。
阶段二，7.5-9.5秒：天象大招成形——头顶云层翻涌化作金色圣光海，万道圣光从云层向下劈落，两人仍保持悬空状态。
阶段三，9.5-15.0秒：本体原地施法出招，圣光海持续压向恶魔，全程伴随圣光粒子倾泻。圣光海从7.5秒成形后一直存在，直到终结技后才缓缓消散，中途不消失、不与本体合并。

【全局前置设定（画质与质感）】
摄影增强版参数包：高端写实 3D Anime Cinematic、Photorealistic Game CG，UE5.4 Path Tracing，顶级院线动作摄影质感。PBR 物理材质，纯白鎏金机甲的磨损划痕金属反射、羽翼的羽毛纤维纹理、金色光环的辉光散射、圣剑的冷冽金属光泽、黑甲的哑光质感精密还原。电影级 ACES 高动态范围、自然高光滚降、真实镜头曝光、细腻景深、体积光、圣光粒子层、云海反射与空气透视；保留原图厚涂油画笔触，画面锐利但不塑料，黑位有层次，亮部不溢出，机甲与羽翼绝不糊成一块。
整体定位：天界战场圣光机甲天使大战暗翼恶魔，写实电影感 CG，圣光普照、厚重油画质感的神圣史诗氛围。两人有来有回：每一次出手都有当场的应对与反击，暗翼恶魔前半段两度占上风，圣光天使直到最后一记才赢下。
特效体系：亮金圣光剑痕 对 深紫暗影刃 + 厚涂油画笔触 + 圣光粒子、羽毛碎屑、云浪碎末

【运镜规格】
全程一镜到底，绝对禁止硬切、冻结、静止机位、拖沓慢动作。35mm 手持跟拍/电影镜头，全程1.0-1.5Hz高频呼吸微抖，0.08s极低惯性延迟，动态快门1/2000s。摄影机像被角色牵引而非旁观，每次加速、减速、转向都由天使、恶魔或圣光海的力量触发。人物机甲面部、握圣剑的手、圣剑剑刃、圣光剑痕优先保持清晰，背景允许速度拖影；光刃高速经过镜头时产生极短失焦再立即锁焦。人物朝向严格以每一拍写明的为准：写背对镜头就只拍背影，写侧对镜头就只露侧脸，不许自行转身正面对着镜头。

[Shot 1]
0-1.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】0帧画面与参考图完全一致——纯白鎏金机甲天使悬浮在云海高空，金色光环在头顶，双翼展开，右手持圣剑，圣光从上方倾泻而下，左侧立着残破的刻文石碑；0.3秒前方暗云里一道深紫暗影刃横劈而来，刃风过处云海被劈开一道长沟，溅起暗紫色光屑；天使抬圣剑横挡，亮金与深紫两色火花在他身前炸开，暗影刃被拦腰斩散。运镜：镜头贴着云海在天使前方倒退，暗影刃劈来时镜头朝那个方向猛地一甩，画面轻轻一震，金紫两色光尘与羽毛碎屑扑向镜头。
1.5-3.0秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】暗翼恶魔从暗云中冲出，两人相向悬空冲锋，天使转为侧对镜头，面朝画面左侧的恶魔；恶魔举暗影战刃自上而下劈落，天使举圣剑横架，刃剑相交处炸开金紫两色火花，两人同时被震得向后倒飞数米，仍稳稳悬浮在空中。运镜：镜头横移到两人之间的侧面，跟着暗影战刃劈下的方向猛地一压，焦点从暗刃切到被压弯的圣剑剑刃，画面轻轻一震，火花沿刃剑交界处成串迸射。
3.0-4.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】天使借倒飞的惯性旋身，圣剑侧面的剑脊狠狠撞在恶魔胸口的暗水晶护甲上，那里崩出一个裂隙，深紫光屑从裂隙里溅出；恶魔顺势拍动暗翼卸力，两人擦身而过、交换位置，天使仍侧对镜头。运镜：镜头绕着交错的两人转半圈，焦点从圣剑剑脊切到恶魔胸口崩开的裂隙，画面轻轻一震，金色光尘与深紫光屑一起飞溅。
4.5-6.0秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】恶魔拍动四对暗翼，甩出数十道暗影飞刃，同时抬手在天使脚下召出深紫深渊法阵，法阵爆发的冲击波正撞在天使的机甲护腿上，把他掀退十余米，天使被撞得背对镜头，右侧的鎏金光羽被暗风掀得猎猎翻卷，数根白羽被削落。运镜：镜头在天使身后，跟着他倒滑向后弹开，拍他的背影和迎面扑来的暗影飞刃，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，云浪碎末与深紫光片炸满画面。
6.0-7.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·无天象大招】恶魔乘势挥刃连劈三刀，第三刀劈在天使身侧的云海中，炸起数十米高的暗紫色水浪；天使被震得压低下身，以圣剑拄着下方的云海撑住，侧对镜头，肩甲被暗刃划出一道划痕，头顶的金光环却骤然亮了数倍。运镜：水浪炸起时镜头向后弹开，再从上往下俯拍他压低下身的侧影，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，云海裂开、圣光粒子炸起。
7.5-9.5秒：【状态：两人悬空·天象大招成形】天使抬手举圣剑向天，头顶的金光环爆发出刺眼金光，头顶厚重的云层骤然翻涌，化作一片金色的圣光海，万道碗口粗的圣光从圣光海中向下劈落，所过之处暗云瞬间消散；几乎同时，恶魔也召出一片暗紫色的雷云，与金色圣光海在高空对峙。两人侧对镜头悬空对峙，左侧的残破刻文石碑在气浪中纹丝不动。运镜：镜头被气浪推着急速后拉、拔高到数里外的超远视角，两人本体缩成云海上方一明一暗两个小点，再缓缓推回两者之间。
9.5-12.0秒：【状态：天象大招对战·本体悬空同步】金色圣光海侧对镜头，面朝暗紫色雷云。恶魔先动，暗雷云劈出数十道紫雷，恶魔本体同步挥出一道巨大的暗影刃；天使侧身让过紫雷，暗刃擦着他的肩甲冲过，撕下一大片鎏金机甲碎块，碎块坠进云海炸成一片金光；天使借侧身之势把圣剑举到最高，身后的羽翼同时展开射出数百道金色光刃，圣光海同步翻涌出数道金色巨浪压向恶魔。运镜：镜头在两者之间横移，暗刃冲过时镜头被气浪撞得向后一仰，画面被冲击震得明显晃动，金光、云浪与深紫光屑在两侧翻涌。
12.0-15.0秒：【状态：天象大招对战·本体悬空同步·终结技】天使与头顶的圣光海同时发动——圣剑挥出一道横贯云海的金色光刃，正正劈进恶魔胸口先前那个裂隙；擦身交错的一瞬，画面闪了一帧纯白，所有声音被抽空；再出现时，天使已悬浮在恶魔身后数步，背对恶魔、正面朝向镜头，圣剑斜拖在身侧。半拍之后，天使肩甲的碎金屑缓缓飘落；恶魔胸口的裂隙才彻底崩裂，整个人化作漫天深紫光屑，暗雷云也随之消散，冲击波由近到远一路扫过云海，左侧的残破刻文石碑在冲击中猎猎作响但未倒，圣光海缓缓化作金色光点散去。天使侧过半张机甲脸，最后半秒姿态精准定格——斜拖的圣剑、扬起的白羽、头顶的金光环、漫天的金光与紫屑全部静止。定格全片只此一次。运镜：镜头在天使身前缓缓后退，冲击波到达时画面剧烈晃动、整个画面被亮金的光闪白了三下、画面发晕，随即稳在他身前的中景，最后半秒画面完全定住不动，定格前一刻画面轻轻一震（圣剑微颤）。

【负面提示词】
严禁硬切镜头，多机位剪辑，黑屏转场，空镜头，生硬转场
严禁任何血液、伤口、断肢，所有受击全程由金色光尘、暗紫光屑、机甲碎甲、羽毛碎屑表现。严禁任何血液、伤口、断肢，所有受击全程由金色光尘、暗紫光屑、机甲碎甲、羽毛碎屑表现。
严禁过度运动模糊，糊脸，融图糊成一团；严禁逆光过曝糊成一片，严禁画面丢失黑位与层次
严禁出现字幕，水印，文字，台词，对话，诗词；严禁出现参考图上下的黑边
严控手指与手部结构（握剑、抬臂、挥剑精准，严防多指畸形），严防白羽、鎏金光羽、机甲高速运动穿模
严禁任何人物中途落地、下坠或凭空换成站立状态；严禁圣光海在7.5秒前出现、在9.5秒后消失或与本体合并
严禁任何一方站着不动挨打，每一次出手都要有当场的应对与反击；严禁人物无故转身正面对着镜头，人物朝向以每一拍写明的为准
严禁出现第三个角色；严禁残破刻文石碑在同一镜头内位置漂移或凭空生长

【禁止项】

文字/UI/水印/Logo/角标/可读文字/真实UI

【强制声明】

无背景音乐,仅保留环境音与人声和音效;画面禁字幕/文字/水印/Logo;禁止可读文字(指画面字幕文字,不含人声台词)
